sentences.text: Pawpawsaurus is a nodosaurid ankylosaur whose name translates to 'Pawpaw Lizard'.
This medium-sized dinosaur measured approximately 4.5 meters in total length.
It is the only known nodosaurid species to possess bony eyelids, a trait usually found in ankylosaurids.
The skull featured a horny beak and a unique arrangement of skin plates above the cranium.
Cameron Campbell found the fossil in the Paw Paw Formation of Tarrant County, Texas, during May 1992.
Y. N. Lee formally described the species Pawpawsaurus campbelli in 1996 based on a complete skull lacking the lower jaw.
The reconstructed brain measured 96 mm in length and 35 mm in width.
Hearing capabilities were relatively poor, similar to those seen in modern crocodilians.
However, the sense of smell was more powerful than in many contemporary theropods due to large nasal cavities.
Scientists suggest these enlarged cavities may have helped cool blood entering the brain or detect danger.
The genus Texasetes, also found in the Paw Paw Formation, might eventually be considered a junior synonym of Pawpawsaurus.
The animal lived in North America during the Albian stage of the middle Cretaceous, between 106.3 and 100.5 million years ago.
Vickaryous et al. (2004) proposed that Pawpawsaurus forms a basal polytomy with Sauropelta and Silvisaurus nested deep to Cedarpelta.
Conversely, a 2018 analysis by Rivera-Sylva and colleagues placed the species within the clade Struthiosaurini as a relative of Struthiosaurus.
Another 2017 analysis by Brown et al. positioned Pawpawsaurus in a clade with Borealopelta and Europelta.
